member.name: T:GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.EthernetIP.Adapter.AdapterController
member.summary: Runs the device as an EtherNet/IP Adapter (the server side of EIP — what a PLC scanner connects to). Wraps the native OpENer stack with a managed-C# API.

remarks.para: Singleton: only one instance can exist at a time. Disposing or calling resets the singleton flag so a fresh controller can be constructed.

Identity, Message Router, Connection Manager, Assembly, and QoS classes are auto-initialized in if user code didn't already register them. So a minimal adapter that only adds Assembly objects works out-of-the-box.

member.name: M:GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.EthernetIP.Adapter.AdapterController.#ctor(System.String,System.UInt16,System.UInt16,System.UInt16,System.UInt32,System.Byte,System.Byte)
member.summary: Construct the adapter. Identity values are set on the underlying CIP Identity object but the network stack isn't started yet — call after wiring up assemblies and connection points.
member.param: Human-readable product name (Identity attr 7). Must match the ProdName field in your EDS file.
ODVA-assigned vendor ID (CIP UINT). Must match the VendCode field in your EDS file. ODVA values 1–99 are reserved for specific companies.
CIP device type per Vol 1 Appendix A (e.g. 0x000C = Generic Device).
32-bit serial number (Identity attr 6). Should be unique per physical device — typically read from non-volatile storage.
member.exception: Thrown if another AdapterController is already constructed and hasn't been disposed (singleton enforcement).

member.name: E:GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.EthernetIP.Adapter.AdapterController.ReceivedExplicitTcpData
member.summary: Fires for every explicit TCP encapsulation command received (RegisterSession, UnregisterSession, SendRRData, SendUnitData, etc.). Argument commandCode is an value. Mostly diagnostic; for real connection state, use the lifecycle-specific events below.

member.name: E:GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.EthernetIP.Adapter.AdapterController.ReceivedExplicitUdpData
member.summary: Fires for every explicit UDP encapsulation command received (ListIdentity, ListServices, ListInterfaces). unicast is true if the request came via UDP unicast vs broadcast.

member.name: E:GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.EthernetIP.Adapter.AdapterController.NotifyClass
member.summary: Fires when any CIP class on this device is accessed by a scanner. Diagnostic — lets you log which class/instance/attribute the scanner touched.

member.name: E:GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.EthernetIP.Adapter.AdapterController.AfterAssemblyDataReceived
member.summary: Fires after a Class-1 implicit packet has been received and copied into the assembly's data buffer. Use this hook to react to scanner-written output values.

member.name: E:GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.EthernetIP.Adapter.AdapterController.BeforeAssemblyDataSend
member.summary: Fires immediately before a Class-1 implicit packet is sent. Hook to refresh input-assembly values from your application state just before the wire goes out.

member.name: E:GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.EthernetIP.Adapter.AdapterController.RegisterSessionDetected
member.summary: Fires when a scanner successfully registers an encapsulation session (TCP RegisterSession command). Argument is the originator's IP.

member.name: E:GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.EthernetIP.Adapter.AdapterController.UnregisterSessionDetected
member.summary: Fires when a scanner closes its encapsulation session (UnregisterSession command). Argument is the originator's IP.

member.name: E:GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.EthernetIP.Adapter.AdapterController.ForwardOpenDetected
member.summary:
Fires when a Forward Open (regular or large) succeeds — a CIP connection is now open. large argument is true for Large Forward Open (service 0x5B), false for regular (service 0x54).
As of Phase 3.5 this only fires on successful Forward Opens; failed attempts (resource exhaustion, electronic key mismatch, etc.) no longer trigger a phantom event.

member.name: E:GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.EthernetIP.Adapter.AdapterController.ForwardCloseDetected
member.summary: Fires when a Forward Close completes — the named CIP connection is being torn down.

member.name: M:GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.EthernetIP.Adapter.AdapterController.AddAssemblyObject(GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.EthernetIP.Adapter.AssemblyObject)
member.summary: Register a Class 4 (Assembly) instance the scanner can read or write via implicit (Class 1) or explicit messaging. Auto-creates the Assembly class itself on first call if not already present.
member.param: Assembly description. The backing Data byte[] is held by raw pointer on the native side — keep it alive (static or long-lived field) for the controller's lifetime, otherwise the GC may free it and the next Class-1 send reads garbage.

member.name: M:GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.EthernetIP.Adapter.AdapterController.ConfigureExclusiveOwnerConnectionPoint(System.UInt32,System.UInt32,System.UInt32,System.UInt32)
member.summary: Register an Exclusive Owner connection point — the standard bidirectional Class-1 I/O connection. Scanner writes the output assembly, reads the input assembly, configures via the configuration assembly.
member.param: 0-based slot index. Up to OPENER_CIP_NUM_EXLUSIVE_OWNER_CONNS exclusive-owner connections can be defined (currently 1).
Instance ID of the O→T (output) assembly (scanner writes here).
Instance ID of the T→O (input) assembly (target produces here).
Instance ID of the configuration assembly, sent during Forward Open.

member.summary: Register an Input Only connection point — scanner just reads the input assembly with no outputs (a "heartbeat" connection sized 0 for O→T).

member.name: M:GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.EthernetIP.Adapter.AdapterController.ConfigureListenOnlyConnectionPoint(System.UInt32,System.UInt32,System.UInt32,System.UInt32)
member.summary: Register a Listen Only connection point — a secondary scanner subscribes to the same multicast input data the Exclusive Owner is receiving, without owning the connection.

member.name: M:GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.EthernetIP.Adapter.AdapterController.Enable
member.summary: Start the EtherNet/IP stack: opens the four CIP sockets (TCP 44818, UDP 44818 unicast + broadcast, UDP 2222 for Class 1), spawns the OpENer processing thread, and auto-creates any standard CIP class (Identity, Message Router, Connection Manager, Assembly, QoS) that user code didn't already register via AddCipClass.
member.remarks: Idempotent guard: throws if already enabled. Use (or ) to tear down before re-enabling.
member.exception: Thrown if the controller is already enabled.

member.name: M:GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.EthernetIP.Adapter.AdapterController.Disable
member.summary: Stop the EtherNet/IP stack. Equivalent to . Idempotent — safe to call multiple times. Resets the singleton flag so a fresh controller can be constructed afterwards.

member.name: M:GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.EthernetIP.Adapter.AdapterController.Dispose
member.summary: Tear down all native state cleanly: signals g_end_stack=1, polls up to 1 s for the OpENer thread to terminate (during which it calls ShutdownCipStack to close all CIP connections and delete every registered class), frees the 8 KB thread stack, and resets the singleton flags so a fresh can be constructed. Idempotent. Suitable for use in a using block.

member.name: M:GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.EthernetIP.Adapter.AdapterController.EnableHeaderO2T(System.Boolean)
member.summary:
Toggle the 32-bit Run/Idle header on O→T (output) Class-1 data. Must be true when talking to Allen-Bradley ControlLogix/CompactLogix scanners — they always prepend a Run/Idle header. False for most other scanner brands (HMS Anybus, Codesys). Default: false.
Symptom of wrong setting: the first 4 bytes of your output assembly oscillate between 0x00000000 and 0x00000001 every cycle instead of holding real scanner-written data.

member.name: M:GHIElectronics.TinyCLR.EthernetIP.Adapter.AdapterController.EnableHeaderT2O(System.Boolean)
member.summary: Toggle the 32-bit Run/Idle header on T→O (input) Class-1 data. Less commonly required than O2T; defaults to false. Enable if your scanner's configuration expects it.
